checks.name: appkit-config-and-usage-silent-hang
checks.implication: These readiness dependencies have no supplied AbortSignal or application deadline. They can keep WalletConnect pending and thereby hide healthy accounts in the shared account selector.

checks.name: near-all-balances-immediate-rejection
checks.implication: The chain swallows all asset RPC failures and resolves an empty successful result. Portfolio therefore cannot distinguish unavailable from verified zero and can hide the affected chain.

checks.name: near-all-balances-silent-hang
checks.implication: NEAR's balance fetch has no supplied AbortSignal or deadline. The affected chain query stays pending; other independently queried chains are not awaited here.

checks.name: xc-swap-rejected-registry-promise-remains-cached
checks.implication: The client caches its failed token-registry promise. Retrying destination assets on the same client never reaches the recovered service.
